extra_quotes: To simulate the frequency - and time-domain responses of the SAW sensor, an electromechanical model was developed in COMSOL Multiphysics ® [37], as shown in Fig. 1.
The time-domain response of the SAW sensor was experimentally measured at the operating frequencies of 146 MHz and 143 MHz, as shown in Fig. 4b.
The present study focuses exclusively on the SAW propagation characteristics and transient response of the sensor, rather than its magnetic -field sensing performance.
